124:t_108:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「I can't stay as cold as you!」

124:t_108:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Keep your own heart under control. The battles ahead are that kind of battle.」

124:t_108:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't die, $$カレン$$. If you disappeared too, $$ルルーシュ$$ would be far too sad.」

124:t_108:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「...Got it. I'll remember your words!」

124:t_109:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(So $$キリコ$$ senses something too...)

124:t_109:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
($$新地球皇国$$... the $$サイデリアル$$... Beyond being invaders, their very existence makes my skin crawl...)

124:t_109:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(Where is this war... headed, I wonder...)

124:t_110:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「I won't waver anymore...! Those who start wars... they are the enemy I must defeat... In other words, evil!」

124:t_111:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't push yourself, $$ヒルデ$$! No going down in a blaze of glory here!」

124:t_111:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I know...! Our fight goes on until we've liberated the Earth!」

124:t_111:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「If you know that, we're good! Don't you die, $$ヒルデ$$!」

124:t_112:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... If their power expands any further, it will be too late to undo the damage...!」

124:t_112:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「We strike their core as soon as possible... To do that, we need to bring our forces together.」

124:t_113:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So my comrades in arms have gathered on this land as well.」

124:t_113:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「The power to resist the Empire is not dead yet.」

124:t_113:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We will fight too...! To bring peace back to this Earth once more!」

124:t_114:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come on, $$サイデリアル$$! I'll pay you back right here for what you did in $$新日本$$!」

124:t_114:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't think you've won until you've stopped my heart! Even if I'm the last one left, I'll fight you!」

124:t_115:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you understand the difference in power, hurry up and raise the white flag. You don't want to die, do you?」

124:t_115:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know, you see. For all your fine words, you're always living with despair.」

124:t_115:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「No, I don't plan to. If you ask me, you've got it better, since you can still hold on to hope.」

124:t_115:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This overwhelming emotion... Hatred that swallows everything...」

124:t_115:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you won't follow us, I'll just hurry up and release the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$...!」

124:t_115:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Before that, I'll repaint the hope and despair inside you in nothing but despair!」
